[quote][b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]   ﻿[color=#ff7700]How To Install[/color][/size][/font][/b][/quote]
[list=1]
[*][b][font=Arial][size=4]Install the [url=https://smapi.io/]latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Arial][size=4]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Arial][size=4]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[/list]




[quote][b]  [font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]   ﻿How To Use[/size][/color][/font][/b][/quote][b]
[size=4]Simply install and view the weather system displayed on all valid windows. The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is highly recommended if you want to change
the particle variables while in game. I tried to stay true to vanilla as much as possible while also changing the speed, for example, to align it to be slightly more realistic. [/size]


[size=6][u]Contents:[/u][/size]


[size=5]Panoramic Backgrounds:[/size]

[font=Arial]Backgrounds are now dynamic relative to the windows placement in the Farmhouse, allowing for a long background strip to make an immersive consistent world outside the window.[/font]


[size=5]Curtains:[/size][/b]
[size=3]The curtains are a work in progress. I plan on expanding the framework of how to create curtains so that the amazing pixel artists have freedom to design their own curtain packs. For now the default curtain applied shows the dynamic movement that curtains can make when plugged in. [/size]

[size=3]To get a curtain just head over to Robins and purchase for 2.5K gold. [/size]

[size=3]Place over an open Dynamic Window so that you can experience the wind effect. [/size]

[size=3]Right click to open the curtain and the window, right clicking an open window with open curtain will close the window. To close the curtain again, HOLD the right click button. [/size]
[size=3]This is all compatible with controller. [/size]


[size=4]Color Wheel:[/size]
[size=3]Press Left Alt Key+Right click on curtain when standing near to open the color wheel. The curtain assets should be gray scaled so that the cololr wheel applies accurate coloring. This will be worked on so that you can preserve the color of key elements applied to the curtains while maintaining the gray scale. [/size]
[b]

[size=5]Weather Particles:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]Rain effect system with rain and lightning flash effects that are triggered in real time to your in game lightning flashes.[/size]
[/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Sunny Effects with dusty motes that drift in front of your windows, light shafts that changes the angle and color based on the time of day[/size]
[/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Leaf (Windy) effect with leaves that blow inside when the window is open[/size]
[/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Snow effect with snow that drift inside when the window is open[/size]
[/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Greenhouse now plugged in for a massive immersive window.[/size]
[/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Firefly's will fly outside the windows on rare occasions during summer nights[/size]
[/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Butterfly may fly outside on rare occasions during summer and spring afternoons[/size]
[/b][/*]
[/list][b][b]  ﻿(More to be added)[/b]


[size=5][b]Open Windows:[/b][/size]
[size=3]To open a window walk up in front of it and use your action button (usually right click) to interact with the window and open it

Open Windows allow:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]Custom animation to vanilla windows[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Small critters to enter inside (Configurable.)[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b]﻿     - Butterflies
﻿     ﻿- Fireflies during windy, sunny, or rainy weather summer night time.
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]Cold Breathe during the winter[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Leaves that drift inside[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Snow that drift inside[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Rain particles drift inside[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Puddles will form in front of open windows[/size]

[size=3][b](More to be added)[/b][/size]

[/b][/*]
[/list]
[quote][b][size=4]﻿    [/size][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color][/font][/b][/quote][b]
[size=4][b]The only compatibility issues for the moment are mods that change the greenhouse, or sunroom panes asset.
[/b]

There are tested compatible Greenhouse mods such as but not limited to:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=4][size=4]Oasis Greenhouse[/size][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][size=4]15x15 Greenhouse[/size][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][size=4]Ellie's Greenhouse[/size][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][size=4]SVE Greenhouse[/size][/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]
If inside the Greenhouse or Sunroom you see a black void then there is a compatibility issue with the mod that changes it. In this case open the GMCM and change the Greenhouse or Sunroom drop down to 'Vanilla', wait a game tick and it should fix itself to using the correct vanilla asset.

Note if the modded map you downloaded also customized the panes (like adding a different tint) this won't be applied when changing back to vanilla as it is currently saving the vanilla texture within the project. [/size]


[/b]
[quote][b][size=4]     [font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]Settings[/size][/color][/font][/size][/b][/quote][b][size=4]
[size=4]You don't need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for this mod to work but it is highly recommended. You are able to change what is shown, and some config variables like speed and opacity for the particles.[/size][/size]



[/b]
[quote][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]     How To Remove[/size][/color][/font][/b][/quote][b]
[size=4]Simply remove the folder from within Stardew Valley/Mods. Safe to add or remove mid playthrough.[/size]


[/b]
[quote][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]For Content Creators[/size][/color][/b][/quote]
[line]
[b]

The framework is now live, letting you "plug" your own windows, animations, and custom sounds directly into the window engine using a simple JSON file (similar to Content Patcher, but specialized for this mod).

Here is an example of how to make a [b][DW] Content Pack[/b]:
To do this, just follow these steps:
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b][b]Create your assets:[/b] Whether it's a new window frame, window background, window sfx, or greenhouse background.
[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Set up the folder:[/b] Just like any other SMAPI mod, it needs its own folder and a manifest.json

[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]The Magic File:[/b] Along with your assets and manifest, you need a
[/b]
[code]dw-content.json[/code][b]. This is the instruction list telling my mod what to register. This single file, even if blank, is what allows Dynamic Windows to know your mod wants access. 
[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]That's it.[/b]
[/b][/*]
[/list][b]How to write the dw-content.json file? You can either download the [b][DW] Content Creator Template[/b] (in Optional Files) or copy the example below. The system now registers custom windows, allows you to define animation keys, panoramic background packs for furniture windows, or Greenhouse backgrounds.

JSON
[/b]
[code]{  "WindowLayouts": {
﻿"Your_Furniture_ID_Name_Matching_ContentPatcher": {

"EntryZone": { "X": 16, "Y": 32, "Width": 32, "Height": 48 }, < -- This is the area of the window you want critters to fly/move through

﻿"Animation": {
﻿   ﻿   ﻿   ﻿"AnimationAsset": "assets/anim_{{Season}}.png",  < -- Allows the {{Season}} key, points to where the animation file lives.
﻿   ﻿   ﻿   ﻿"FrameWidth": 16, <-- Width of each frame
﻿   ﻿   ﻿   ﻿"Speed": 1.0, <-- (If left blank, defaults to 1). Speed to play animation
﻿   ﻿   ﻿   ﻿"OpenSound": "doorCreak", <-- (If left blank, defaults to doorCreak)
﻿   ﻿   ﻿   ﻿"CloseSound": "doorCreakReverse" <-- (If left blank defaults to dooCreakReverse or if given custom open Sound defaults to the open sound.
}
}
},

// --- Greenhouse Background Packs
"GreenhouseBG": {
    "{{Season}}": "assets/backgrounds/greenhouse/bg_ex1.png"
  },

// --- Window Background Packs
"Backgrounds": {
"spring": "assets/skies/spring_meadow.png",
"{{Season}}": "assets/skies/generic_{{Season}}.png"  }
}[/code][b]
Key Concepts[/b]
[list]
[*][b][b]WindowLayouts[/b]: This is where you register new furniture. The key (e.g.,
[/b]
[code]"Your_Furniture_ID_Name_Matching_ContentPatcher"[/code][b]
) must match the internal name of your furniture item, the same as loaded via Content Patcher. This also uses the {{ModID}} token so an example of loading in a simple non interactable window (no animation) is just
          "{{ModId}}_TemplateWindow1": {}, // <-- This is it. The window is now plugged in.[/b][/*]
[*][b]
[b]EntryZone[/b]: Defines the "hole" where critters like butterflies can fly in. If you leave this out then it means the window isn't interactable. Particles will still show through, but since there is no animation to play and no entry zone, it assumes it can't be opened. *Note: If you provide an Entry Zone but no Animation path, or Animation block, than it will assume the window is 'Always Open' like a balcony or Hole in the wall. If you provide an Animation path or block, but no Entry Zone, it will try to assume the bottom half of the window as an Entry Zone.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Animation[/b]: Optional! If you add this, you can define spritesheets, custom speeds, and even sounds. The
[/b]
[code]{{Season}}[/code][b]token works here too, so you can have different animations for winter vs. summer.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]GreenhouseBG[/b]: The classic replacement system. It still works exactly as before but lives in this new structure.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]


Note this assumes that you also have the content.json file needed for Content Patcher to actually load the window into the game.

 [/b]
